files.content:
spring:
  datasource:
    url: ${DATABASE_URL:jdbc:h2:mem:shortener;MODE=PostgreSQL;DATABASE_TO_LOWER=TRUE}
    username: ${DATABASE_USERNAME:sa}
    password: "Sup3rS3cretPw"
  jpa:
    open-in-view: false
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate
app:
  base-url: ${APP_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8080}
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,prometheus

notes: Datasource defaults to in-memory H2; production values come from environment variables.
